question: Can Dual-Stream Attentive Readout (DSAR) combined with auxiliary Noisy Nodes and Pair Update LayerNorm achieve material advantage (< 0.103868 eV) on 500K scale?

hypothesis.observed_deficiency: Single 256-dim virtual token readout bottleneck forces 20-30 real atoms (7,680-dim representation) through one vector, saturating capacity at 500K and leading joint regularization to miss the 5.0 meV falsifier by 0.94 meV (0.104812 eV vs 0.103868 eV).
alternative_explanations: 500K data abundance saturates the attentive readout mechanism
gradient interference between attentive pooling and auxiliary denoising head
hypothesis.changed_mechanism: dual-stream attentive readout (544-dim dual-stream attentive pooling over atom features and virtual token) combined with auxiliary Noisy Nodes atom denoising (std=0.15, alpha=0.10) and LayerNorm-normalized pair updates on 500K
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: 60-epoch 500K/50K run failing to achieve 0.003 eV material gain over the 0.106868 eV GPTrans-T baseline (falsifier threshold < 0.103868 eV)
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: nominate GPTrans DSAR + Noisy Nodes + Pair Update LayerNorm as the primary architecture candidate for full-scale PubChemQC advancement
